title: VB3-16 interchange: export table row, events.jsonl, status=tombstoned (VB8-04)
description: Mirrors tools/bm_vault_export.py's build_events() output for a state["tombstoned"] row exactly (bm_vault_events.fold()'s own tombstoned shape, plus the status column build_events adds). See export_events_live_row.schema.json for why this is a distinct shape rather than one schema with an optional field: a tombstoned row carries tombstone_event_key and no winning_event_key/winning_kind/root_event_key at all.
